compact.description: Tighter gaps between indicators and icons.
compact.label: Compact spacing

display_mode.description: How this bar shows its monitor's workspaces. Navigator is the default; each bar can use a different mode.
display_mode.label: Display mode

indicator_size.description: Scales indicators, numbers and spacing. Keep the stack within the bar thickness.
indicator_size.label: Indicator size

max_windows.description: Maximum window icons shown; the rest collapse into a +N counter. 0 shows all.
max_windows.label: Maximum window icons

show_empty.description: Show empty workspaces, including the one niri keeps at the bottom of each monitor.
show_empty.label: Show empty workspaces

show_numbers.description: Show the active workspace's number (or name) next to the rail or mini map.
show_numbers.label: Show numbers

show_windows.description: Show the windows of the active workspace next to the stack.
show_windows.label: Show windows

visible_workspaces.description: How many workspaces the rail and mini map show at once, centered on the active one. Limited to what fits the bar height (4 needs compact spacing).
visible_workspaces.label: Visible workspaces

tooltip.active_unfocused: Active on {output} — another monitor has focus
tooltip.navigator: Position {position} of {total} · scroll to move, click for the list
tooltip.window_current: current window here (keyboard focus is elsewhere) · click to focus
